purpose: Deliver the frozen v4.2 manuscript PDF as user deliverables (byte copy, source zip, delivery record). No research stage exists in this run.
frozen: written before any stage ran; only the evidence block is appended by the runner

allowed_stages.what: PDF header, bytes, sha256, git blob, page count and body-end page against the recorded v4.2 facts; every input hash
byte copy of paper/main.pdf to deliverables/<pdf_name>; sha256 equality
deliverables/P3_source.zip from the listed tracked paper sources plus a generated BUILD.md; deterministic zip; identifying-string report (no redaction)

optional: unzip into the session scratch folder and build with -halt-on-error -no-shell-escape; compare page count and per-page text with the delivered PDF; paper/main.pdf is never rebuilt or replaced
deliverables/P3_delivery.json with commit, hashes, pages, style, build commands, pages viewed, research status, file list
by hand: STATUS.md eighth session, run_manifest.json eighth_session, one delivery note in paper/README.md and RESEARCH_PACKET.md
one ordinary commit on the current branch; push under the already granted branch policy

forbidden_in_this_run: new topic, dose, KL, feature, model, semantic judge, generation, activation check, readout-closure rerun
deleting or renaming existing export_bundle packages
installs, downloads, GPU, paid API, web compiler, conference submission, release, other-branch push, force push
stop_conditions: paper/main.pdf hash, size or page facts differ from the recorded v4.2 values (STOP_MISMATCH; nothing is delivered)
any listed input hash differs from the freeze (STOP_MISMATCH)
the deliverable copy is not byte-identical
the zip self-build fails: allowed response is one minimal fix of the member list and one rerun; no protocol change

limits.network: GitHub API reads and git push by the caller only; none inside the runner

skip_rule: copy_pdf, source_zip and build_check are skipped when the recorded evidence matches the current inputs/outputs

source_zip.not_included: Not included: paper/README.md and paper/claims.csv (internal records; in the repository and the internal package), raw results and code (export_bundle packages / repository), the PDF (delivered separately as the .pdf file).

style.version: icml2026.sty: ICML 2026 LaTeX style, 'version of 2025-10-29' (file header); used with \usepackage{icml2026} (anonymous review mode)
style.description: Official ICML 2026 style files (icml2026.sty, header 'version of 2025-10-29'; icml2026.bst; algorithm.sty; algorithmic.sty; fancyhdr.sty), unmodified and not renamed, loaded as \usepackage{icml2026} (anonymous review mode). They serve as the temporary template while the ICML 2027 instructions are not obtained (TARGET_YEAR = 2027, TEMPLATE_YEAR = 2026). Fonts, margins and spacing are the style defaults.

recorded.description: The delivered PDF was built once on 2026-10-05 from these sources with the session TeX Live 2026 (scheme-basic plus the packages listed below; pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.29, BibTeX 0.99e) by four passes in paper/. Flags as recorded: -interaction=nonstopmode; the log shows 'restricted \write18 enabled' (the pdfTeX default; -no-shell-escape was not passed) and -halt-on-error was not passed. Nothing was sent to a web compiler.
